synthetic_history.history_note: Author-selected sufficient statistics representing three years for a hypothetical 100-vehicle portfolio. Claim amounts are assumed fully developed and expressed on the insurer-indemnity basis.

insurer.premium_earning_and_collection_timing: Equal monthly instalments earned and collected in coverage months 1-12.
insurer.claim_expense_cash_timing: Claim expense is paid with claim settlement; reserving is measured at the end of month 12.

moove_driver_economics.collections_note: Expected portfolio ledger assumes scheduled package cash is collected. Delinquency, cure and household liquidity are assessed separately by running the unchanged 156-week Mwendo case for each profile and repair scenario.

integration.integration_rule: The existing case's 12-day and 2-day repair scenarios supply the operating bridge. Portfolio claim downtime is a separate annual fleet projection. Do not add portfolio downtime to the one-claim Mwendo repair ledger or count one repair invoice in both ledgers.
